removed_integrations.reason: The exact recorded package combination reproduced a browser initialization compatibility defect in the coupled Twoslash/FloatingVue desktop drag and text-selection patch. Removal is a shipped capability boundary, not a claim that every package or ordinary type hover is obsolete or inoperative.

evidence.runtime_observation: Real Chromium with CLI/client 53.0.0, @shikijs/vitepress-twoslash 4.5.0 and floating-vue 5.4.0 logged 'Failed to patch FloatingVue'. The caught TypeError reading Popper came from a desktop drag/text-selection patch assuming VMenu.components.Popper.extends when VMenu.components was absent. Ordinary type hover worked; that observation does not establish clean startup or working patched drag/text-selection interoperability. No workaround, compatibility shim or log suppression is shipped.

removed_integrations.exclusion_quote: Slidev and its Twoslash/FloatingVue integration are removed from the shipped Vue Kit capability set; their source records are historical exclusions, not supported implementation guidance.
reintroduction_requirements: A supported compatible source or release fix repairs the integration defect; a latest tag alone is insufficient.
Clean startup in a real browser without the FloatingVue patch failure, workaround, shim or log suppression.
Verified tooltip, type-query and completion behavior plus drag/text-selection acceptance through keyboard and pointer interactions.
Verified production behavior and integration on the Vue 3.5.44 baseline, not only a successful build.
